svg.title: Scaling of the case families
svg.desc: Time against the number of rows for PostgreSQL and pg_sift on several query shapes.
svg.text: Scaling of 24 query shapes: time against rows
Median ms, both axes logarithmic. The number at each line is its slope: 1.0 is time proportional to the rows, lower is better.

svg.text: Data: docs/results/cases-scale.tsv, 2026-10-24, AMD Ryzen 9 5900XT 16-Core Processor, one backend, medians of interleaved runs; sizes 100k,
300k, 1M, 2M. The slope is the least-squares slope of log time on log rows over all sizes.
